programs.title_fil: Pensyon ng lungsod para sa senior citizen (Local Senior Pension)
programs.for_fil: Para sa mga senior citizen na 65 taong gulang pataas na mahina, may sakit o may kapansanan, at walang pensyon, permanenteng pinagkukunan ng kita o regular na suporta mula sa kamag-anak. Kasama rin ang tumatanggap ng buwanang pensyon ng SSS na ₱4,000 pababa. Hindi kasama sa itinuturing na pensyon ang social pension ng DSWD.
programs.for_en: Senior citizens aged 65 and above who are frail, sickly or with disability and have no pension, permanent source of income or regular support from relatives. Seniors receiving an SSS pension of ₱4,000 a month or less also qualify. The DSWD social pension is not counted as a pension.
programs.benefit_fil: ₱500 kada buwan. Ipinamamahagi ito kada quarter: sa Landbank ATM at sa ATM ng iba pang bangko sa Bancnet, o sa manual payout sa itinakdang venue.
programs.benefit_en: ₱500 per month, distributed quarterly: withdrawn from Landbank ATMs and other Bancnet ATMs, or collected at a scheduled manual payout
programs.how_fil: Kumuha ng application form sa barangay hall sa pamamagitan ng OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer at isumite ito kasama ang photocopy ng Senior Citizen ID. Hindi lahat ng senior citizen ay makakakuha ng LSP.
programs.how_en: Get the application form at your barangay hall through the OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer and submit it with a photocopy of your Senior Citizen ID. Not all senior citizens receive the LSP.

programs.title_fil: Pamaskong cash gift para sa senior citizen
programs.for_fil: Mga senior citizen na may Pasig Senior Benefit Card.
programs.for_en: Pasig senior citizens who hold the Senior Benefit Card
programs.how_fil: Kumuha ng Senior Citizens Benefit Card (Landbank ATM) sa pamamagitan ng application form sa barangay hall, sa OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer.
programs.how_en: Apply for the Senior Citizens Benefit Card (Landbank ATM) with the application form at your barangay hall through the OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer

programs.title_fil: Cash gift para sa mga senior citizen na umabot sa edad 80, 85, 90, 95 at 100
programs.title_en: Cash gift for seniors reaching ages 80, 85, 90, 95 and 100
programs.for_fil: Mga Pasigueño na umabot sa edad 80, 85, 90, 95 at 100 at nakatira na sa Pasig nang hindi bababa sa 2 taon.
programs.for_en: Pasigueños who reach ages 80, 85, 90, 95 and 100 and have lived in Pasig for at least 2 years
programs.benefit_fil: Liham ng pagbati mula sa Mayor at cash gift na ₱10,000 sa edad 80, ₱15,000 sa edad 85, at ₱25,000 sa edad 90, 95 at 100.
programs.benefit_en: A letter of felicitation from the Mayor and a cash gift of ₱10,000 at age 80, ₱15,000 at age 85, and ₱25,000 at ages 90, 95 and 100
programs.how_fil: Magsumite ng application form sa barangay hall sa pamamagitan ng OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer, kasama ang authenticated na kopya ng birth certificate mula sa PSA, photocopy ng Senior Citizen ID at whole-body na larawan na naka-print sa A4 na papel.
programs.how_en: Submit the application form at your barangay hall through the OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer, with an authenticated PSA birth certificate, a photocopy of your Senior Citizen ID and a whole-body photo printed on A4 paper
programs.note_fil: Para sa taong 2025 lamang ang Ordinance No. 18, s. 2025, na nagdagdag ng mga edad na 81-84, 86-89, 91-94 at 96-99 para sa taong iyon.
programs.note_en: Ordinance No. 18, s. 2025 (age bands 81-84, 86-89, 91-94 and 96-99) applied to calendar year 2025 only.

programs.title_fil: Tulong pampalibing para sa senior citizen
programs.for_fil: Pamilya ng namatay na senior citizen na may Pasig Senior Benefit Card. Ang spouse, mga anak o apo, mga magulang o lolo't lola, o kapatid ng namatay ang puwedeng mag-claim, o ang informant sa death certificate kung wala sila.
programs.for_en: Family of a deceased holder of a Pasig Senior Benefit Card: the spouse, descendants, ascendants or siblings, or the informant on the death certificate in their absence
programs.how_fil: Mag-claim sa loob ng 30 araw ng trabaho mula sa pagpaparehistro ng death certificate (45 araw ng trabaho kung nasa labas ng Pasig ang namatay para sa gamutan o bakasyon). Dalhin ang certified true copy ng death certificate, dalawang valid ID ng claimant, ang orihinal na Senior ID at ATM/cash card stub, at patunay ng relasyon sa namatay.
programs.how_en: File the claim within 30 working days of the death certificate's registration (45 working days if the senior died while away from Pasig for treatment or a trip). Bring the certified true copy of the death certificate, two valid IDs of the claimant, the original Senior ID and ATM/cash card stub, and proof of relationship to the deceased.

programs.title_fil: Libreng bakuna, pagpapaospital at konsulta para sa senior citizen
programs.title_en: Free vaccines, hospitalization and consultation for seniors
programs.for_fil: Mga senior citizen na may Pasig Senior Benefit Card
programs.for_en: Pasig senior citizens who hold the Senior Benefit Card
programs.benefit_fil: Libreng bakuna laban sa trangkaso kada taon at bakuna laban sa pneumonia (pneumococcal) minsan kada 5 taon, o isang beses na panghabambuhay na bakuna. Libreng pagpapaospital, laboratory at medical services sa Pasig City General Hospital para sa mga na-confine. Libreng konsulta at gamot sa lahat ng barangay health center.
programs.benefit_en: Free yearly flu vaccine and pneumococcal vaccine once every 5 years (or a one-time lifetime pneumococcal vaccine). Free hospitalization, laboratory and medical services for confined seniors at Pasig City General Hospital. Free consultation and medicines at all barangay health centers.
programs.how_fil: Ipakita ang Senior Benefit Card. Kumuha nito sa pamamagitan ng application form sa barangay hall, sa OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer.
programs.how_en: Show your Senior Benefit Card. Apply for it with the application form at your barangay hall through the OSCA Senior Help Desk Officer.
programs.office: OSCA / Pasig City General Hospital / City Health Office

programs.title_fil: Buwanang ayuda para sa solo parent
programs.for_fil: Mga solo parent na kumikita ng minimum wage pababa at hindi tumatanggap ng ibang cash assistance o subsidy mula sa iba pang programa ng gobyerno. Puwede pa ring tumanggap ng benepisyo ng senior citizen o PWD ang solo parent na senior citizen o PWD. Noong Setyembre 2025, 4,276 ang kasama sa pamamahagi.
programs.for_en: Solo parents earning minimum wage or below who do not receive other cash assistance or subsidy from other government programs. A solo parent who is also a senior citizen or PWD may keep those benefits. 4,276 were included in the September 2025 payout.
programs.benefit_fil: ₱1,000 kada buwan. Quarterly ang pamamahagi: noong Hulyo 24, 2026, ipinasok ang cash subsidy para sa Abril hanggang Hunyo 2026 sa Landbank ATM card o GCash Visa card ng mga eligible na solo parent na nag-validate noong Mayo 2026. Noong Setyembre 2025, namahagi ng ₱3,000 para sa Abril hanggang Hunyo. Sa ilalim din ng pambansang Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act, may ₱1,000 kada buwan para sa mga kwalipikadong solo parent.
programs.benefit_en: ₱1,000 per month, paid quarterly. On July 24, 2026 the April-June 2026 subsidy was credited to the Landbank ATM cards or GCash Visa cards of eligible solo parents who validated in May 2026. The September 2025 payout covered April-June: ₱3,000. The national Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act also provides ₱1,000 monthly to qualified solo parents.
programs.how_fil: Sa ATM card ibinibigay ang ayuda, at puwede itong i-withdraw sa anumang ATM o sa ATM ng iba pang bangko sa BancNet (may minimal transaction fee). Sa mga barangay idinaan ang unang pamamahagi. Magtanong sa barangay mo. Puwedeng kumuha ang kinatawang malapit na kapamilya o kamag-anak kung may authorization letter.
programs.how_en: Paid by ATM card, withdrawable at any ATM or any BancNet bank ATM (minimal transaction fee). The first batch was distributed at barangays. Ask your barangay. A representative may claim with an authorization letter (immediate family/relatives only).
programs.office: City Social Welfare and Development Office / barangay

programs.for_fil: Mga taong may kapansanan na taga-Pasig na na-validate ng PDAO noong nakaraang taon. Tanging mga validated na PWD noong nakaraang taon ang mabibigyan ng cash gift.
programs.for_en: Pasig persons with disability who were validated by PDAO in the previous year. Only PWDs validated the previous year receive the cash gift.
programs.benefit_fil: ₱1,500 na taunang financial assistance para sa mga bonafide na PWD ng Pasig. Noong Oktubre 2025, ipinamahagi ang cash gift na hindi pa nakukuha noong 2024 ng humigit-kumulang 2,000 PWD.
programs.benefit_en: ₱1,500 annual financial assistance for bonafide Pasig PWDs (October 2025 release of unclaimed 2024 gifts to about 2,000 PWDs)
programs.preview_fil: ₱1,500 kada taon para sa mga kwalipikadong PWD sa Pasig.
programs.preview_en: ₱1,500 per year for eligible Pasig residents with disabilities.
programs.how_fil: Kunin sa schedule at venue ng barangay mo na ipinapahayag ng PDAO. Kung ikaw mismo ang mag-claim, dalhin ang orihinal na PWD ID at photocopy nito na may tatlong pirma o thumb mark. Puwede ring kumuha ang authorized representative na may authorization letter at iba pang kinakailangang dokumento. Makikita ang listahan ng tatanggap sa PWD Office o help desk ng barangay.
programs.how_en: Claim on the schedule and venue announced by PDAO for your barangay. If you claim in person, bring your original PWD ID and a photocopy with three signatures or thumb marks. An authorized representative may claim with an authorization letter and the other required documents. The list of recipients is posted at the PWD Office or barangay help desk.

programs.title_fil: Tulong pinansyal sa mga taong may kapansanan na may negosyo
programs.title_en: Financial assistance for PWD-run small businesses
programs.for_fil: Mga PWD o kanilang tagapag-alaga na mayroon nang micro o maliit na negosyo sa Pasig. May 200 slot noong 2023.
programs.for_en: PWDs (or their guardians) already running a micro/small business in Pasig; 200 slots in the 2023 round
programs.how_fil: Isumite mismo sa PDAO ang business profile, maikling liham, barangay certificate of indigency, mga kopya ng PWD ID at valid ID, at mga larawan ng negosyo.
programs.how_en: Submit business profile, short letter, barangay certificate of indigency, PWD ID and valid ID copies, and business photos in person at PDAO
programs.office: Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO), (02) 643-1111 loc. 1162
programs.note_fil: Para sa 2023 ang impormasyong ito. Kumpirmahin sa PDAO kung tumatanggap ngayon ng aplikasyon.

programs.for_fil: Mga Pilipinong 2 taon o higit nang nakatira sa Pasig na may sambahayang nasa Listahanan o may kita na hindi hihigit sa ₱35,000 kada buwan. Dapat kumuha ng College Readiness Test at may balak mag-enroll sa priority program ng pribadong HEI o TVI na may kasunduan sa Lungsod ng Pasig. Hindi puwedeng may ibang scholarship o study grant. Isang miyembro lang ng pamilya ang puwedeng mabigyan sa isang semestre o school year.
programs.for_en: Filipinos who have lived in Pasig for at least 2 years, whose household is in the Listahanan or earns no more than ₱35,000 a month. Applicants must have taken the College Readiness Test and intend to enroll in a priority program at a private HEI or TVI with a Memorandum of Agreement with the City of Pasig. No other scholarship or study grant is allowed. Only one member of the immediate family may be a beneficiary in a given semester or school year.
programs.benefit_fil: Hindi hihigit sa ₱35,000 kada semestre para sa tuition at iba pang gastos sa edukasyon sa kolehiyo hanggang matapos ang kurso, at hindi hihigit sa ₱56,000 kada semestre para sa Bachelor of Science in Nursing.
programs.benefit_en: Not more than ₱35,000 per semester toward tertiary education costs until course completion, and not more than ₱56,000 per semester for Bachelor of Science in Nursing
programs.preview_fil: Hanggang ₱35,000 kada semestre (₱56,000 kada semestre para sa BS Nursing).
programs.preview_en: Up to ₱35,000 per semester (₱56,000 per semester for BS Nursing).
programs.how_fil: Punan ang application form at isumite ang mga dokumento sa Pasig City Education Department bago ang deadline na itatakda ng Scholarship Board. Mag-abang ng anunsyo sa pasigcity.gov.ph para sa application period.
programs.how_en: Fill up the application form and submit the supporting documents to the Pasig City Education Department before the deadline set by the Scholarship Board. Watch pasigcity.gov.ph for application periods.
programs.office: Pasig City Education Department / Scholarship Board

programs.for_fil: Mga estudyante sa kolehiyo na umabot sa itinakdang ranggo. Sa isang panahon ng aplikasyon, 1,789 ang napili sa 3,389 na kwalipikadong aplikante.
programs.for_en: College students who pass ranking; 1,789 selected from 3,389 eligible applicants in one cycle
programs.how_fil: Mag-apply kapag tumatanggap na ng aplikasyon ang lungsod. Kung hindi ka napili, puwede kang umapela sa tanggapan ng PCS sa loob ng 5 araw ng trabaho.
programs.how_en: Apply when the city opens the cycle; non-selected applicants can appeal to the PCS office within 5 working days

programs.title_en: Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Pasig (city university)
programs.for_fil: Mga papasok sa unang taon na may GWA na 80% o mas mataas. Kailangang 5 taon o higit nang nakatira sa Pasig ang aplikante, magulang o tagapag-alaga. Puwede rin ang mga kwalipikadong lilipat sa ikalawa o ikatlong taon na may GWA na 2.25 o mas mataas.
programs.for_en: Incoming freshmen with GWA ≥ 80% whose applicant/parent/guardian has lived in Pasig for 5+ years; qualified 2nd/3rd-year transferees (GWA 2.25 or better)
programs.benefit_fil: Unibersidad ito ng lungsod na itinatag sa bisa ng Ordinance No. 11, s. 1999 ng Sangguniang Panlungsod noong Marso 15, 1999. Walang nakasaad na tuition sa mga sanggunian.
programs.benefit_en: City-run university established by Ordinance No. 11, s. 1999 of the Sangguniang Panlungsod on March 15, 1999. Tuition terms were not stated in the sources.
programs.how_fil: Mag-apply online sa PLP Online Admission Application Form. Bukas ang application para sa Academic Year 2027-2028 mula Setyembre 21 hanggang Nobyembre 30, 2026.
programs.how_en: Apply online through the PLP Online Admission Application Form. Applications for Academic Year 2027-2028 are open from September 21 to November 30, 2026.
programs.note_fil: Para sa pagpasok noong 2023 ang mga requirement na ito.
programs.note_en: Requirements are from the 2023 admission cycle.

programs.title_fil: Tulong sa internet at pamasahe para sa K-12
programs.for_fil: Mga mag-aaral mula Kindergarten hanggang Grade 12 sa mga pampublikong paaralan ng Lungsod ng Pasig
programs.for_en: Kindergarten to Grade 12 learners of public schools in Pasig City
programs.benefit_fil: ₱1,500 na one-time internet at transportation allowance kada mag-aaral para sa School Year 2023-2024 (ipinamahagi noong Setyembre 2023)
programs.benefit_en: ₱1,500 one-time internet and transportation allowance per learner for School Year 2023-2024 (distributed in September 2023)
programs.office: City Government of Pasig / DepEd Pasig

programs.for_fil: Mga pasyenteng nakarehistro sa Pasig Mental Health Program. Ayon sa Mental Health Office, puwede ring makakuha ng serbisyo ang mga hindi taga-Pasig.
programs.for_en: Patients enrolled in the Pasig Mental Health Program (non-residents also served, per the Mental Health Office)
programs.benefit_fil: Libreng gamot mula sa DOH. May stock ng 22 uri ng gamot noong Enero 2026.
programs.benefit_en: Free medicines (22 types in stock as of January 2026, DOH-supplied)
programs.how_fil: Magparehistro sa pinakamalapit na barangay health center. Magdala ng balidong reseta at valid ID. Dalhin din ang medical certificate kung mayroon.
programs.how_en: Register at the nearest barangay health center; bring a valid prescription, a valid ID and a medical certificate if available
programs.office: Pasig City Mental Health Office / barangay health centers

programs.for_fil: Mga residente at establisimyento sa Pasig
programs.benefit_fil: Ginamit ng lungsod ang QR system na ito para sa COVID-19 contact tracing at pagpaparehistro para sa bakuna. Kinukumpirma pa kung saan ito ginagamit ngayon.
programs.benefit_en: City QR system used for COVID-19 contact tracing and as registration for vaccination; current uses not confirmed
programs.note_fil: Batay ito sa mga pamagat sa resulta ng paghahanap noong 2020-2021. Wala pang sangguniang nagsasaad kung saan ito ginagamit ngayon.
programs.note_en: Based on search-result titles from 2020-2021; no source for present-day uses.
